title: An-Nazi'at 79:41-46 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nazi'at 79:41-46 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 34. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (٤١) يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا (٤٢) فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ (٤٣) إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ (٤٤) إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا (٤٥) كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا (٤٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
To your Lord is its finality.
You are only a warner for those who fear it.
It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Light hum, tongue ready for ذ

keywords.def: the Hour, the Day of Judgement

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nazi'at 79:41-46 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 79:41-46 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:41-46 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of An-Nazi'at 79:1 to 46 to a partner.
What does 79:46 compare our time in this world to?
questions.a: An afternoon or its morning: life will feel very short.

questions.q: To whom does the knowledge of the Hour belong (79:44)?
questions.a: A) Allah alone. 79:44: 'To your Lord is its finality.'

questions.q: Think again: People asked the Prophet ﷺ when the Hour will come (79:42). Why might Allah keep that knowledge hidden?
questions.a: So that we are always ready and do good now; knowledge of it is with Allah alone (79:44).
